City View High Tea
Apr 2026 • Couples
What a wonderful place for High Tea! Stunning City views from Level 48 of the Iconic Landmark 81. We booked a 3:30pm time slot on purpose to enjoy the carefully crafted Vietnamese style Afternoon Tea with bottomless tea and coffee. Each of the delectable morsels hand crafted by expert chefs was a delight to behold. One thing of note was the unusual ratio of savoury to sweet with the majority of our fare being savoury. This particularly pleased my Chef wife who prefers savoury to sweet. We finished in time to witness a burning red sunset over the Saigon skyline sipping some exquisite liqueur patiently awaiting the light show of buildings to ignite the evening sky. Our waitress for the afternoon and evening, Bella, performed her duties inexplicably. In fact all of the staff were very attentive and respectful and thanked us in person when leaving which we both thought was a lovely touch.

Lovely Tea-Style Lunch at Landmark 81
Nov 2025 • Family
I visited The Cloud at Landmark 81 for their lunch/tea-time set, and it ended up being one of the best experiences I’ve had in Ho Chi Minh City. The servers Phuc and Joy took care of our table without being intrusive, which I really appreciated. The whole experience felt relaxing and well put together. The food was delicious, and the staff were so friendly. I’d recommend The Cloud to anyone visiting Landmark 81.

Cocktails and Confections.
Aug 2025 • Couples
I booked (online) the sunset hour. Although, the rain came, we had a memorable time with team. We ordered the 10 piece chicken without champagne. These come boneless (which the menu did not denote); tasty, but not something I'd recommend. Happy hour drinks were tastefully crafted with Lance and Dylan providing background history. The salt caramelised latte (Vietnamese style) was superb and highly recommended. Mr Khoi kept the birthday portion a surprise, and brought out a small but delightful cake. We still ordered "The Cloud" dessert which was a sticky, chocolatey marvel. This is something to gaze upon but also a dessert worth sharing. It's a small serving but packs a punch balancing sweet, bitter and creaminess. Come for the views, rain or shine. And if you are a Marriott member they honour the Bonvoy points.
